title: Agent generations cannot set PromptBox parameters - add a named-parameter layer to generation.submit
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-561 - The controls a generation actually used (consolidation sweep 2026-08-14). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-561/plan.md.

MPI-546 shipped generation.submit, but an agent can only inherit whatever the open project happens to be set to. It cannot choose a ratio, resolution, quality tier, turbo, style or batch for a specific generation. The goal: an agent is asked for a specific generation with specific settings on a specific model, and can do it. No UI reflection required - the PromptBox does not need to change to match, per Fabio 2026-08-12.

BLOCKED-BY (found 2026-08-13 during MPI-546 live verification): MPI-556. A sidecar records the project's controls, not the run's - so a parameter delivered as a raw injection key generates correctly and is then unreproducible from Reuse. Raw injectionParams always wins over resolved values, so the named-parameter layer inherits this. Fix MPI-556 first or MPI-547 ships generations that cannot be reused.
